fields.quoted_span: an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for that dwelling or unit at any time during the 12 months prior to the effective date of the increase.
fields.note: Every element of the requirement matches the statute: base, discount exclusion, two increments, new-tenancy initial rent, § 827 notice, sublease limit, CPI definition and rounding, waiver void, remedies, enforcement by the AG/city attorney/county counsel, and the 3-year limit. One small point: the document says the owner is liable in a civil action to the tenant, and the requirement's summary is consistent with that.

fields.quoted_span: shall not be increased in more than two increments over that 12-month period
fields.note: The lower-of-5%+CPI-or-10% cap, the two-increment limit, and the repeal on Jan. 1, 2030 are all supported by D024. The LAHD figures (8.9% and 8.8%) do not appear in D024, which is the only document provided, so they cannot be verified here.

fields.quoted_span: (n) This section shall become operative on April 1, 2024.
fields.note: The current version is operative April 1, 2024 and was effective January 1, 2024, as the document's history note states.

fields.quoted_span: (o) This section shall remain in effect until January 1, 2030, and as of that date is repealed.
fields.note: The section is currently operative (since April 1, 2024) and sunsets Jan. 1, 2030, so in_force is consistent.

fields.quoted_span: Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome.
fields.note: The 15-year rolling exemption, mobilehome carve-out, owner conditions (REIT, corporation, LLC with a corporate member, mobilehome park management, written notice), owner-occupied duplex, affordable housing, dormitories, local rent control that is stricter, the March 15, 2019 / Feb. 18, 2021 application dates, and the mobilehome homeowner exclusion all match the document.

fields.quoted_span: Repealed (in Sec. 3) and added by Stats. 2023, Ch. 290, Sec. 4.   (SB 567)   Effective January 1, 2024.
fields.note: The document is Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12 and cites Stats. 2023, ch. 290 (SB 567). The aliases AB 1482 and Tenant Protection Act of 2019 do not appear in D024, but the primary citation is confirmed.
